---
title: "Covariance & Correlation Structures"
description: "Research on statistical inference for covariance and correlation matrices and structures."
---

I develop inference procedures for hypotheses concerning covariance and correlation structures in general multivariate designs, including comparisons between groups and testing for specific patterns or structural restrictions.

This research line connects methodology for general covariance hypotheses, correlation matrices, structured patterns, and statistical software.

## Related Work

- Sattler, Bathke & Pauly (2022), *Testing hypotheses about covariance matrices in general MANOVA designs*
- Sattler & Pauly (2023), *Testing hypotheses about correlation matrices in general MANOVA designs*
- Sattler & Dobler (2026), *Testing for patterns and structures in covariance and correlation matrices*
- [CovCorTest](../software/covcortest.qmd)
